# async_nats - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/async-nats/0.49.1/async_nats/index.html

## Expand description

A Rust asynchronous client for the NATS.io ecosystem.

To access the repository, you can clone it by running:

`git clone https://github.com/nats-io/nats.rs`NATS.io is a simple, secure, and high-performance open-source messaging system designed for cloud-native applications, IoT messaging, and microservices architectures.

**Note**: The synchronous NATS API is deprecated and no longer actively maintained. If you need to use the deprecated synchronous API, you can refer to:
[https://crates.io/crates/nats](https://crates.io/crates/nats)

For more information on NATS.io visit: [https://nats.io](https://nats.io)

[§](https://docs.rs#examples)Examples

Below, you can find some basic examples on how to use this library.

For more details, please refer to the specific methods and structures documentation.

[§](https://docs.rs#complete-example)Complete example

Connect to the NATS server, publish messages and subscribe to receive messages.

```
use bytes::Bytes;
use futures_util::StreamExt;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
    // Connect to the NATS server
    let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
    // Subscribe to the "messages" subject
    let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("messages").await?;
    // Publish messages to the "messages" subject
    for _ in 0..10 {
        client.publish("messages", "data".into()).await?;
    }
    // Receive and process messages
    while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
        println!("Received message {:?}", message);
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#publish)Publish

Connect to the NATS server and publish messages to a subject.

```
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
// Prepare the subject and data
let subject = "foo";
let data = Bytes::from("bar");
// Publish messages to the NATS server
for _ in 0..10 {
    client.publish(subject, data.clone()).await?;
}
// Flush internal buffer before exiting to make sure all messages are sent
client.flush().await?;
```
[§](https://docs.rs#subscribe)Subscribe

Connect to the NATS server, subscribe to a subject and receive messages.

```
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
// Subscribe to the "foo" subject
let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("foo").await.unwrap();
// Receive and process messages
while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
    println!("Received message {:?}", message);
}
```
[§](https://docs.rs#jetstream)JetStream

To access JetStream API, create a JetStream [jetstream::Context](https://docs.rs/jetstream/context/struct.Context.html).

```
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
// Create a JetStream context.
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
// Publish JetStream messages, manage streams, consumers, etc.
jetstream.publish("foo", "bar".into()).await?;
```
[§](https://docs.rs#key-value-store)Key-value Store

Key-value [Store](https://docs.rs/jetstream/kv/struct.Store.html) is accessed through [jetstream::Context](https://docs.rs/jetstream/context/struct.Context.html).

```
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
// Create a JetStream context.
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
// Access an existing key-value.
let kv = jetstream.get_key_value("store").await?;
```
[§](https://docs.rs#object-store)Object Store

Object [Store](https://docs.rs/jetstream/object_store/struct.ObjectStore.html) is accessed through [jetstream::Context](https://docs.rs/jetstream/context/struct.Context.html).

```
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
// Create a JetStream context.
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
// Access an existing key-value.
let kv = jetstream.get_object_store("store").await?;
```
[§](https://docs.rs#service-api)Service API

[Service API](https://docs.rs/service/struct.Service.html) is accessible through [Client](https://docs.rs/client/struct.Client.html) after importing its trait.

```
use async_nats::service::ServiceExt;
// Connect to the NATS server
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let mut service = client
    .service_builder()
    .description("some service")
    .stats_handler(|endpoint, stats| serde_json::json!({ "endpoint": endpoint }))
    .start("products", "1.0.0")
    .await?;
```

## Modules[§](https://docs.rs#modules)

[13](https://docs.rs#13)
[14](https://docs.rs#14)//! A Rust asynchronous client for the NATS.io ecosystem.
[15](https://docs.rs#15)//!
[16](https://docs.rs#16)//! To access the repository, you can clone it by running:
[17](https://docs.rs#17)//!
[18](https://docs.rs#18)//! ```bash
[19](https://docs.rs#19)//! git clone https://github.com/nats-io/nats.rs
[20](https://docs.rs#20)//! ````
[21](https://docs.rs#21)//! NATS.io is a simple, secure, and high-performance open-source messaging
[22](https://docs.rs#22)//! system designed for cloud-native applications, IoT messaging, and microservices
[23](https://docs.rs#23)//! architectures.
[24](https://docs.rs#24)//!
[25](https://docs.rs#25)//! **Note**: The synchronous NATS API is deprecated and no longer actively maintained. If you need to use the deprecated synchronous API, you can refer to:
[26](https://docs.rs#26)//! <https://crates.io/crates/nats>
[27](https://docs.rs#27)//!
[28](https://docs.rs#28)//! For more information on NATS.io visit: <https://nats.io>
[29](https://docs.rs#29)//!
[30](https://docs.rs#30)//! ## Examples
[31](https://docs.rs#31)//!
[32](https://docs.rs#32)//! Below, you can find some basic examples on how to use this library.
[33](https://docs.rs#33)//!
[34](https://docs.rs#34)//! For more details, please refer to the specific methods and structures documentation.
[35](https://docs.rs#35)//!
[36](https://docs.rs#36)//! ### Complete example
[37](https://docs.rs#37)//!
[38](https://docs.rs#38)//! Connect to the NATS server, publish messages and subscribe to receive messages.
[39](https://docs.rs#39)//!
[40](https://docs.rs#40)//! ```no_run
[41](https://docs.rs#41)//! use bytes::Bytes;
[42](https://docs.rs#42)//! use futures_util::StreamExt;
[43](https://docs.rs#43)//!
[44](https://docs.rs#44)//! #[tokio::main]
[45](https://docs.rs#45)//! async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[46](https://docs.rs#46)//!     // Connect to the NATS server
[47](https://docs.rs#47)//!     let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[48](https://docs.rs#48)//!
[49](https://docs.rs#49)//!     // Subscribe to the "messages" subject
[50](https://docs.rs#50)//!     let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("messages").await?;
[51](https://docs.rs#51)//!
[52](https://docs.rs#52)//!     // Publish messages to the "messages" subject
[53](https://docs.rs#53)//!     for _ in 0..10 {
[54](https://docs.rs#54)//!         client.publish("messages", "data".into()).await?;
[55](https://docs.rs#55)//!     }
[56](https://docs.rs#56)//!
[57](https://docs.rs#57)//!     // Receive and process messages
[58](https://docs.rs#58)//!     while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
[59](https://docs.rs#59)//!         println!("Received message {:?}", message);
[60](https://docs.rs#60)//!     }
[61](https://docs.rs#61)//!
[62](https://docs.rs#62)//!     Ok(())
[63](https://docs.rs#63)//! }
[64](https://docs.rs#64)//! ```
[65](https://docs.rs#65)//!
[66](https://docs.rs#66)//! ### Publish
[67](https://docs.rs#67)//!
[68](https://docs.rs#68)//! Connect to the NATS server and publish messages to a subject.
[69](https://docs.rs#69)//!
[70](https://docs.rs#70)//! ```
[71](https://docs.rs#71)//! # use bytes::Bytes;
[72](https://docs.rs#72)//! # use std::error::Error;
[73](https://docs.rs#73)//! # use std::time::Instant;
[74](https://docs.rs#74)//! # #[tokio::main]
[75](https://docs.rs#75)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[76](https://docs.rs#76)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[77](https://docs.rs#77)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[78](https://docs.rs#78)//!
[79](https://docs.rs#79)//! // Prepare the subject and data
[80](https://docs.rs#80)//! let subject = "foo";
[81](https://docs.rs#81)//! let data = Bytes::from("bar");
[82](https://docs.rs#82)//!
[83](https://docs.rs#83)//! // Publish messages to the NATS server
[84](https://docs.rs#84)//! for _ in 0..10 {
[85](https://docs.rs#85)//!     client.publish(subject, data.clone()).await?;
[86](https://docs.rs#86)//! }
[87](https://docs.rs#87)//!
[88](https://docs.rs#88)//! // Flush internal buffer before exiting to make sure all messages are sent
[89](https://docs.rs#89)//! client.flush().await?;
[90](https://docs.rs#90)//!
[91](https://docs.rs#91)//! #    Ok(())
[92](https://docs.rs#92)//! # }
[93](https://docs.rs#93)//! ```
[94](https://docs.rs#94)//!
[95](https://docs.rs#95)//! ### Subscribe
[96](https://docs.rs#96)//!
[97](https://docs.rs#97)//! Connect to the NATS server, subscribe to a subject and receive messages.
[98](https://docs.rs#98)//!
[99](https://docs.rs#99)//! ```no_run
[100](https://docs.rs#100)//! # use bytes::Bytes;
[101](https://docs.rs#101)//! # use futures_util::StreamExt;
[102](https://docs.rs#102)//! # use std::error::Error;
[103](https://docs.rs#103)//! # use std::time::Instant;
[104](https://docs.rs#104)//! # #[tokio::main]
[105](https://docs.rs#105)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[106](https://docs.rs#106)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[107](https://docs.rs#107)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[108](https://docs.rs#108)//!
[109](https://docs.rs#109)//! // Subscribe to the "foo" subject
[110](https://docs.rs#110)//! let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("foo").await.unwrap();
[111](https://docs.rs#111)//!
[112](https://docs.rs#112)//! // Receive and process messages
[113](https://docs.rs#113)//! while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
[114](https://docs.rs#114)//!     println!("Received message {:?}", message);
[115](https://docs.rs#115)//! }
[116](https://docs.rs#116)//! #     Ok(())
[117](https://docs.rs#117)//! # }
[118](https://docs.rs#118)//! ```
[119](https://docs.rs#119)//!
[120](https://docs.rs#120)//! ### JetStream
[121](https://docs.rs#121)//!
[122](https://docs.rs#122)//! To access JetStream API, create a JetStream [jetstream::Context].
[123](https://docs.rs#123)//!
[124](https://docs.rs#124)//! ```no_run
[125](https://docs.rs#125)//! # #[tokio::main]
[126](https://docs.rs#126)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[127](https://docs.rs#127)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[128](https://docs.rs#128)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[129](https://docs.rs#129)//! // Create a JetStream context.
[130](https://docs.rs#130)//! let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
[131](https://docs.rs#131)//!
[132](https://docs.rs#132)//! // Publish JetStream messages, manage streams, consumers, etc.
[133](https://docs.rs#133)//! jetstream.publish("foo", "bar".into()).await?;
[134](https://docs.rs#134)//! # Ok(())
[135](https://docs.rs#135)//! # }
[136](https://docs.rs#136)//! ```
[137](https://docs.rs#137)//!
[138](https://docs.rs#138)//! ### Key-value Store
[139](https://docs.rs#139)//!
[140](https://docs.rs#140)//! Key-value [Store][jetstream::kv::Store] is accessed through [jetstream::Context].
[141](https://docs.rs#141)//!
[142](https://docs.rs#142)//! ```no_run
[143](https://docs.rs#143)//! # #[tokio::main]
[144](https://docs.rs#144)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[145](https://docs.rs#145)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[146](https://docs.rs#146)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[147](https://docs.rs#147)//! // Create a JetStream context.
[148](https://docs.rs#148)//! let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
[149](https://docs.rs#149)//! // Access an existing key-value.
[150](https://docs.rs#150)//! let kv = jetstream.get_key_value("store").await?;
[151](https://docs.rs#151)//! # Ok(())
[152](https://docs.rs#152)//! # }
[153](https://docs.rs#153)//! ```
[154](https://docs.rs#154)//! ### Object Store
[155](https://docs.rs#155)//!
[156](https://docs.rs#156)//! Object [Store][jetstream::object_store::ObjectStore] is accessed through [jetstream::Context].
[157](https://docs.rs#157)//!
[158](https://docs.rs#158)//! ```no_run
[159](https://docs.rs#159)//! # #[tokio::main]
[160](https://docs.rs#160)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[161](https://docs.rs#161)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[162](https://docs.rs#162)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[163](https://docs.rs#163)//! // Create a JetStream context.
[164](https://docs.rs#164)//! let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
[165](https://docs.rs#165)//! // Access an existing key-value.
[166](https://docs.rs#166)//! let kv = jetstream.get_object_store("store").await?;
[167](https://docs.rs#167)//! # Ok(())
[168](https://docs.rs#168)//! # }
[169](https://docs.rs#169)//! ```
[170](https://docs.rs#170)//! ### Service API
[171](https://docs.rs#171)//!
[172](https://docs.rs#172)//! [Service API][service::Service] is accessible through [Client] after importing its trait.
[173](https://docs.rs#173)//!
[174](https://docs.rs#174)//! ```no_run
[175](https://docs.rs#175)//! # #[tokio::main]
[176](https://docs.rs#176)//! # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[177](https://docs.rs#177)//! use async_nats::service::ServiceExt;
[178](https://docs.rs#178)//! // Connect to the NATS server
[179](https://docs.rs#179)//! let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[180](https://docs.rs#180)//! let mut service = client
[181](https://docs.rs#181)//!     .service_builder()
[182](https://docs.rs#182)//!     .description("some service")
[183](https://docs.rs#183)//!     .stats_handler(|endpoint, stats| serde_json::json!({ "endpoint": endpoint }))
[184](https://docs.rs#184)//!     .start("products", "1.0.0")
[185](https://docs.rs#185)//!     .await?;
[186](https://docs.rs#186)//! # Ok(())
[187](https://docs.rs#187)//! # }
[188](https://docs.rs#188)//! ```

[453](https://docs.rs#453)/// A connection handler which facilitates communication from channels to a single shared connection.
[454](https://docs.rs#454)pub(crate) struct ConnectionHandler {
[455](https://docs.rs#455)    connection: Connection,
[456](https://docs.rs#456)    connector: Connector,
[457](https://docs.rs#457)    subscriptions: HashMap<u64, Subscription>,
[458](https://docs.rs#458)    multiplexer: Option<Multiplexer>,
[459](https://docs.rs#459)    pending_pings: usize,
[460](https://docs.rs#460)    info_sender: tokio::sync::watch::Sender<Option<ServerInfo>>,
[461](https://docs.rs#461)    ping_interval: Interval,
[462](https://docs.rs#462)    should_reconnect: bool,
[463](https://docs.rs#463)    flush_observers: Vec<oneshot::Sender<()>>,
[464](https://docs.rs#464)    is_draining: bool,
[465](https://docs.rs#465)    drain_pings: VecDeque<u64>,
[466](https://docs.rs#466)}
[467](https://docs.rs#467)
[468](https://docs.rs#468)impl ConnectionHandler {
[469](https://docs.rs#469)    pub(crate) fn new(

[473](https://docs.rs#473)        ping_period: Duration,
[474](https://docs.rs#474)    ) -> ConnectionHandler {
[475](https://docs.rs#475)        let mut ping_interval = interval(ping_period);
[476](https://docs.rs#476)        ping_interval.set_missed_tick_behavior(MissedTickBehavior::Delay);
[477](https://docs.rs#477)
[478](https://docs.rs#478)        ConnectionHandler {

[481](https://docs.rs#481)            subscriptions: HashMap::new(),
[482](https://docs.rs#482)            multiplexer: None,

[484](https://docs.rs#484)            info_sender,

[492](https://docs.rs#492)
[493](https://docs.rs#493)    pub(crate) async fn process<'a>(&'a mut self, receiver: &'a mut mpsc::Receiver<Command>) {
[494](https://docs.rs#494)        struct ProcessFut<'a> {
[495](https://docs.rs#495)            handler: &'a mut ConnectionHandler,
[496](https://docs.rs#496)            receiver: &'a mut mpsc::Receiver<Command>,
[497](https://docs.rs#497)            recv_buf: &'a mut Vec<Command>,
[498](https://docs.rs#498)        }
[499](https://docs.rs#499)
[500](https://docs.rs#500)        enum ExitReason {
[501](https://docs.rs#501)            Disconnected(Option<io::Error>),
[502](https://docs.rs#502)            ReconnectRequested,
[503](https://docs.rs#503)            Closed,
[504](https://docs.rs#504)        }
[505](https://docs.rs#505)
[506](https://docs.rs#506)        impl ProcessFut<'_> {
[507](https://docs.rs#507)            const RECV_CHUNK_SIZE: usize = 16;
[508](https://docs.rs#508)
[509](https://docs.rs#509)            #[cold]
[510](https://docs.rs#510)            fn ping(&mut self) -> Poll<ExitReason> {
[511](https://docs.rs#511)                self.handler.pending_pings += 1;
[512](https://docs.rs#512)
[513](https://docs.rs#513)                if self.handler.pending_pings > MAX_PENDING_PINGS {
[514](https://docs.rs#514)                    debug!(
[515](https://docs.rs#515)                        pending_pings = self.handler.pending_pings,
[516](https://docs.rs#516)                        max_pings = MAX_PENDING_PINGS,
[517](https://docs.rs#517)                        "disconnecting due to too many pending pings"
[518](https://docs.rs#518)                    );
[519](https://docs.rs#519)
[520](https://docs.rs#520)                    Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(None))
[521](https://docs.rs#521)                } else {
[522](https://docs.rs#522)                    self.handler.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Ping);
[523](https://docs.rs#523)
[524](https://docs.rs#524)                    Poll::Pending
[525](https://docs.rs#525)                }
[526](https://docs.rs#526)            }
[527](https://docs.rs#527)        }
[528](https://docs.rs#528)
[529](https://docs.rs#529)        impl Future for ProcessFut<'_> {
[530](https://docs.rs#530)            type Output = ExitReason;
[531](https://docs.rs#531)
[532](https://docs.rs#532)            /// Drives the connection forward.
[533](https://docs.rs#533)            ///
[534](https://docs.rs#534)            /// Returns one of the following:
[535](https://docs.rs#535)            ///
[536](https://docs.rs#536)            /// * `Poll::Pending` means that the connection
[537](https://docs.rs#537)            ///   is blocked on all fronts or there are
[538](https://docs.rs#538)            ///   no commands to send or receive
[539](https://docs.rs#539)            /// * `Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(_))` means
[540](https://docs.rs#540)            ///   that an I/O operation failed and the connection
[541](https://docs.rs#541)            ///   is considered dead.
[542](https://docs.rs#542)            /// * `Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Closed)` means that
[543](https://docs.rs#543)            ///   [`Self::receiver`] was closed, so there's nothing
[544](https://docs.rs#544)            ///   more for us to do than to exit the client.
[545](https://docs.rs#545)            fn poll(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Self::Output> {
[546](https://docs.rs#546)                // We need to be sure the waker is registered, therefore we need to poll until we
[547](https://docs.rs#547)                // get a `Poll::Pending`. With a sane interval delay, this means that the loop
[548](https://docs.rs#548)                // breaks at the second iteration.
[549](https://docs.rs#549)                while self.handler.ping_interval.poll_tick(cx).is_ready() {
[550](https://docs.rs#550)                    if let Poll::Ready(exit) = self.ping() {
[551](https://docs.rs#551)                        return Poll::Ready(exit);
[552](https://docs.rs#552)                    }
[553](https://docs.rs#553)                }
[554](https://docs.rs#554)
[555](https://docs.rs#555)                loop {
[556](https://docs.rs#556)                    match self.handler.connection.poll_read_op(cx) {
[557](https://docs.rs#557)                        Poll::Pending => break,
[558](https://docs.rs#558)                        Poll::Ready(Ok(Some(server_op))) => {
[559](https://docs.rs#559)                            self.handler.handle_server_op(server_op);
[560](https://docs.rs#560)                        }
[561](https://docs.rs#561)                        Poll::Ready(Ok(None)) => {
[562](https://docs.rs#562)                            return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(None))
[563](https://docs.rs#563)                        }
[564](https://docs.rs#564)                        Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => {
[565](https://docs.rs#565)                            return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(Some(err)))
[566](https://docs.rs#566)                        }
[567](https://docs.rs#567)                    }
[568](https://docs.rs#568)                }
[569](https://docs.rs#569)
[570](https://docs.rs#570)                // Before handling any commands, drop any subscriptions which are draining
[571](https://docs.rs#571)                // Note: safe to assume subscription drain has completed at this point, as we would have flushed
[572](https://docs.rs#572)                // all outgoing UNSUB messages in the previous call to this fn, and we would have processed and
[573](https://docs.rs#573)                // delivered any remaining messages to the subscription in the loop above.
[574](https://docs.rs#574)                while let Some(sid) = self.handler.drain_pings.pop_front() {
[575](https://docs.rs#575)                    self.handler.subscriptions.remove(&sid);
[576](https://docs.rs#576)                }
[577](https://docs.rs#577)
[578](https://docs.rs#578)                if self.handler.is_draining {
[579](https://docs.rs#579)                    // The entire connection is draining. This means we flushed outgoing messages in the previous
[580](https://docs.rs#580)                    // call to this fn, we handled any remaining messages from the server in the loop above, and
[581](https://docs.rs#581)                    // all subs were drained, so drain is complete and we should exit instead of processing any
[582](https://docs.rs#582)                    // further messages
[583](https://docs.rs#583)                    return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Closed);
[584](https://docs.rs#584)                }
[585](https://docs.rs#585)
[586](https://docs.rs#586)                // WARNING: after the following loop `handle_command`,
[587](https://docs.rs#587)                // or other functions which call `enqueue_write_op`,
[588](https://docs.rs#588)                // cannot be called anymore. Runtime wakeups won't
[589](https://docs.rs#589)                // trigger a call to `poll_write`
[590](https://docs.rs#590)
[591](https://docs.rs#591)                let mut made_progress = true;
[592](https://docs.rs#592)                loop {
[593](https://docs.rs#593)                    while !self.handler.connection.is_write_buf_full() {
[594](https://docs.rs#594)                        debug_assert!(self.recv_buf.is_empty());
[595](https://docs.rs#595)
[596](https://docs.rs#596)                        let Self {
[597](https://docs.rs#597)                            recv_buf,
[598](https://docs.rs#598)                            handler,
[599](https://docs.rs#599)                            receiver,
[600](https://docs.rs#600)                        } = &mut *self;
[601](https://docs.rs#601)                        match receiver.poll_recv_many(cx, recv_buf, Self::RECV_CHUNK_SIZE) {
[602](https://docs.rs#602)                            Poll::Pending => break,
[603](https://docs.rs#603)                            Poll::Ready(1..) => {
[604](https://docs.rs#604)                                made_progress = true;
[605](https://docs.rs#605)
[606](https://docs.rs#606)                                for cmd in recv_buf.drain(..) {
[607](https://docs.rs#607)                                    handler.handle_command(cmd);
[608](https://docs.rs#608)                                }
[609](https://docs.rs#609)                            }
[610](https://docs.rs#610)                            // TODO: replace `_` with `0` after bumping MSRV to 1.75
[611](https://docs.rs#611)                            Poll::Ready(_) => return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Closed),
[612](https://docs.rs#612)                        }
[613](https://docs.rs#613)                    }
[614](https://docs.rs#614)
[615](https://docs.rs#615)                    // The first round will poll both from
[616](https://docs.rs#616)                    // the `receiver` and the writer, giving
[617](https://docs.rs#617)                    // them both a chance to make progress
[618](https://docs.rs#618)                    // and register `Waker`s.
[619](https://docs.rs#619)                    //
[620](https://docs.rs#620)                    // If writing is `Poll::Pending` we exit.
[621](https://docs.rs#621)                    //
[622](https://docs.rs#622)                    // If writing is completed we can repeat the entire
[623](https://docs.rs#623)                    // cycle as long as the `receiver` doesn't end-up
[624](https://docs.rs#624)                    // `Poll::Pending` immediately.
[625](https://docs.rs#625)                    if !mem::take(&mut made_progress) {
[626](https://docs.rs#626)                        break;
[627](https://docs.rs#627)                    }
[628](https://docs.rs#628)
[629](https://docs.rs#629)                    match self.handler.connection.poll_write(cx) {
[630](https://docs.rs#630)                        Poll::Pending => {
[631](https://docs.rs#631)                            // Write buffer couldn't be fully emptied
[632](https://docs.rs#632)                            break;
[633](https://docs.rs#633)                        }
[634](https://docs.rs#634)                        Poll::Ready(Ok(())) => {
[635](https://docs.rs#635)                            // Write buffer is empty
[636](https://docs.rs#636)                            continue;
[637](https://docs.rs#637)                        }
[638](https://docs.rs#638)                        Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => {
[639](https://docs.rs#639)                            return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(Some(err)))
[640](https://docs.rs#640)                        }
[641](https://docs.rs#641)                    }
[642](https://docs.rs#642)                }
[643](https://docs.rs#643)
[644](https://docs.rs#644)                if let (ShouldFlush::Yes, _) | (ShouldFlush::No, false) = (
[645](https://docs.rs#645)                    self.handler.connection.should_flush(),
[646](https://docs.rs#646)                    self.handler.flush_observers.is_empty(),
[647](https://docs.rs#647)                ) {
[648](https://docs.rs#648)                    match self.handler.connection.poll_flush(cx) {
[649](https://docs.rs#649)                        Poll::Pending => {}
[650](https://docs.rs#650)                        Poll::Ready(Ok(())) => {
[651](https://docs.rs#651)                            for observer in self.handler.flush_observers.drain(..) {
[652](https://docs.rs#652)                                let _ = observer.send(());
[653](https://docs.rs#653)                            }
[654](https://docs.rs#654)                        }
[655](https://docs.rs#655)                        Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => {
[656](https://docs.rs#656)                            return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::Disconnected(Some(err)))
[657](https://docs.rs#657)                        }
[658](https://docs.rs#658)                    }
[659](https://docs.rs#659)                }
[660](https://docs.rs#660)
[661](https://docs.rs#661)                if mem::take(&mut self.handler.should_reconnect) {
[662](https://docs.rs#662)                    return Poll::Ready(ExitReason::ReconnectRequested);
[663](https://docs.rs#663)                }
[664](https://docs.rs#664)
[665](https://docs.rs#665)                Poll::Pending
[666](https://docs.rs#666)            }
[667](https://docs.rs#667)        }
[668](https://docs.rs#668)
[669](https://docs.rs#669)        let mut recv_buf = Vec::with_capacity(ProcessFut::RECV_CHUNK_SIZE);
[670](https://docs.rs#670)        loop {
[671](https://docs.rs#671)            let process = ProcessFut {
[672](https://docs.rs#672)                handler: self,
[673](https://docs.rs#673)                receiver,
[674](https://docs.rs#674)                recv_buf: &mut recv_buf,
[675](https://docs.rs#675)            };
[676](https://docs.rs#676)            match process.await {
[677](https://docs.rs#677)                ExitReason::Disconnected(err) => {
[678](https://docs.rs#678)                    debug!(error = ?err, "disconnected");
[679](https://docs.rs#679)                    if self.handle_disconnect().await.is_err() {
[680](https://docs.rs#680)                        break;
[681](https://docs.rs#681)                    };
[682](https://docs.rs#682)                    debug!("reconnected");
[683](https://docs.rs#683)                }
[684](https://docs.rs#684)                ExitReason::Closed => {
[685](https://docs.rs#685)                    // Safe to ignore result as we're shutting down anyway
[686](https://docs.rs#686)                    self.connector.events_tx.try_send(Event::Closed).ok();
[687](https://docs.rs#687)                    break;
[688](https://docs.rs#688)                }
[689](https://docs.rs#689)                ExitReason::ReconnectRequested => {
[690](https://docs.rs#690)                    debug!("reconnect requested");
[691](https://docs.rs#691)                    // Should be ok to ingore error, as that means we are not in connected state.
[692](https://docs.rs#692)                    self.connection.stream.shutdown().await.ok();
[693](https://docs.rs#693)                    if self.handle_disconnect().await.is_err() {
[694](https://docs.rs#694)                        break;
[695](https://docs.rs#695)                    };
[696](https://docs.rs#696)                }
[697](https://docs.rs#697)            }
[698](https://docs.rs#698)        }
[699](https://docs.rs#699)    }
[700](https://docs.rs#700)
[701](https://docs.rs#701)    fn handle_server_op(&mut self, server_op: ServerOp) {
[702](https://docs.rs#702)        self.ping_interval.reset();
[703](https://docs.rs#703)
[704](https://docs.rs#704)        match server_op {
[705](https://docs.rs#705)            ServerOp::Ping => {
[706](https://docs.rs#706)                debug!("received PING");
[707](https://docs.rs#707)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Pong);
[708](https://docs.rs#708)            }
[709](https://docs.rs#709)            ServerOp::Pong => {
[710](https://docs.rs#710)                debug!("received PONG");
[711](https://docs.rs#711)                self.pending_pings = self.pending_pings.saturating_sub(1);
[712](https://docs.rs#712)            }
[713](https://docs.rs#713)            ServerOp::Error(error) => {
[714](https://docs.rs#714)                debug!("received ERROR: {:?}", error);
[715](https://docs.rs#715)                self.connector
[716](https://docs.rs#716)                    .events_tx
[717](https://docs.rs#717)                    .try_send(Event::ServerError(error))
[718](https://docs.rs#718)                    .ok();
[719](https://docs.rs#719)            }
[720](https://docs.rs#720)            ServerOp::Message {
[721](https://docs.rs#721)                sid,
[722](https://docs.rs#722)                subject,
[723](https://docs.rs#723)                reply,
[724](https://docs.rs#724)                payload,
[725](https://docs.rs#725)                headers,
[726](https://docs.rs#726)                status,
[727](https://docs.rs#727)                description,
[728](https://docs.rs#728)                length,
[729](https://docs.rs#729)            } => {
[730](https://docs.rs#730)                debug!("received MESSAGE: sid={}, subject={}", sid, subject);
[731](https://docs.rs#731)                self.connector
[732](https://docs.rs#732)                    .connect_stats
[733](https://docs.rs#733)                    .in_messages
[734](https://docs.rs#734)                    .add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
[735](https://docs.rs#735)
[736](https://docs.rs#736)                if let Some(subscription) = self.subscriptions.get_mut(&sid) {
[737](https://docs.rs#737)                    let message: Message = Message {
[738](https://docs.rs#738)                        subject,
[739](https://docs.rs#739)                        reply,
[740](https://docs.rs#740)                        payload,
[741](https://docs.rs#741)                        headers,
[742](https://docs.rs#742)                        status,
[743](https://docs.rs#743)                        description,
[744](https://docs.rs#744)                        length,
[745](https://docs.rs#745)                    };
[746](https://docs.rs#746)
[747](https://docs.rs#747)                    // if the channel for subscription was dropped, remove the
[748](https://docs.rs#748)                    // subscription from the map and unsubscribe.
[749](https://docs.rs#749)                    match subscription.sender.try_send(message) {
[750](https://docs.rs#750)                        Ok(_) => {
[751](https://docs.rs#751)                            subscription.delivered += 1;
[752](https://docs.rs#752)                            // if this `Subscription` has set `max` value, check if it
[753](https://docs.rs#753)                            // was reached. If yes, remove the `Subscription` and in
[754](https://docs.rs#754)                            // the result, `drop` the `sender` channel.
[755](https://docs.rs#755)                            if let Some(max) = subscription.max {
[756](https://docs.rs#756)                                if subscription.delivered.ge(&max) {
[757](https://docs.rs#757)                                    debug!("max messages reached for subscription {}", sid);
[758](https://docs.rs#758)                                    self.subscriptions.remove(&sid);
[759](https://docs.rs#759)                                }
[760](https://docs.rs#760)                            }
[761](https://docs.rs#761)                        }
[762](https://docs.rs#762)                        Err(mpsc::error::TrySendError::Full(_)) => {
[763](https://docs.rs#763)                            debug!("slow consumer detected for subscription {}", sid);
[764](https://docs.rs#764)                            self.connector
[765](https://docs.rs#765)                                .events_tx
[766](https://docs.rs#766)                                .try_send(Event::SlowConsumer(sid))
[767](https://docs.rs#767)                                .ok();
[768](https://docs.rs#768)                        }
[769](https://docs.rs#769)                        Err(mpsc::error::TrySendError::Closed(_)) => {
[770](https://docs.rs#770)                            debug!("subscription {} channel closed", sid);
[771](https://docs.rs#771)                            self.subscriptions.remove(&sid);
[772](https://docs.rs#772)                            self.connection
[773](https://docs.rs#773)                                .enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Unsubscribe { sid, max: None });
[774](https://docs.rs#774)                        }
[775](https://docs.rs#775)                    }
[776](https://docs.rs#776)                } else if sid == MULTIPLEXER_SID {
[777](https://docs.rs#777)                    debug!("received message for multiplexer");
[778](https://docs.rs#778)                    if let Some(multiplexer) = self.multiplexer.as_mut() {
[779](https://docs.rs#779)                        let maybe_token =
[780](https://docs.rs#780)                            subject.strip_prefix(multiplexer.prefix.as_ref()).to_owned();
[781](https://docs.rs#781)
[782](https://docs.rs#782)                        if let Some(token) = maybe_token {
[783](https://docs.rs#783)                            if let Some(sender) = multiplexer.senders.remove(token) {
[784](https://docs.rs#784)                                debug!("forwarding message to request with token {}", token);
[785](https://docs.rs#785)                                let message = Message {
[786](https://docs.rs#786)                                    subject,
[787](https://docs.rs#787)                                    reply,
[788](https://docs.rs#788)                                    payload,
[789](https://docs.rs#789)                                    headers,
[790](https://docs.rs#790)                                    status,
[791](https://docs.rs#791)                                    description,
[792](https://docs.rs#792)                                    length,
[793](https://docs.rs#793)                                };
[794](https://docs.rs#794)
[795](https://docs.rs#795)                                let _ = sender.send(message);
[796](https://docs.rs#796)                            }
[797](https://docs.rs#797)                        }
[798](https://docs.rs#798)                    }
[799](https://docs.rs#799)                }
[800](https://docs.rs#800)            }
[801](https://docs.rs#801)            // TODO: we should probably update advertised server list here too.
[802](https://docs.rs#802)            ServerOp::Info(info) => {
[803](https://docs.rs#803)                debug!("received INFO: server_id={}", info.server_id);
[804](https://docs.rs#804)                if info.lame_duck_mode {
[805](https://docs.rs#805)                    debug!("server in lame duck mode");
[806](https://docs.rs#806)                    self.connector.events_tx.try_send(Event::LameDuckMode).ok();
[807](https://docs.rs#807)                }
[808](https://docs.rs#808)            }
[809](https://docs.rs#809)
[810](https://docs.rs#810)            _ => {
[811](https://docs.rs#811)                // TODO: don't ignore.
[812](https://docs.rs#812)            }
[813](https://docs.rs#813)        }
[814](https://docs.rs#814)    }
[815](https://docs.rs#815)
[816](https://docs.rs#816)    fn handle_command(&mut self, command: Command) {
[817](https://docs.rs#817)        match command {
[818](https://docs.rs#818)            Command::Unsubscribe { sid, max } => {
[819](https://docs.rs#819)                if let Some(subscription) = self.subscriptions.get_mut(&sid) {
[820](https://docs.rs#820)                    subscription.max = max;
[821](https://docs.rs#821)                    match subscription.max {
[822](https://docs.rs#822)                        Some(n) => {
[823](https://docs.rs#823)                            if subscription.delivered >= n {
[824](https://docs.rs#824)                                self.subscriptions.remove(&sid);
[825](https://docs.rs#825)                            }
[826](https://docs.rs#826)                        }
[827](https://docs.rs#827)                        None => {
[828](https://docs.rs#828)                            self.subscriptions.remove(&sid);
[829](https://docs.rs#829)                        }
[830](https://docs.rs#830)                    }
[831](https://docs.rs#831)
[832](https://docs.rs#832)                    self.connection
[833](https://docs.rs#833)                        .enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Unsubscribe { sid, max });
[834](https://docs.rs#834)                }
[835](https://docs.rs#835)            }
[836](https://docs.rs#836)            Command::Flush { observer } => {
[837](https://docs.rs#837)                self.flush_observers.push(observer);
[838](https://docs.rs#838)            }
[839](https://docs.rs#839)            Command::Drain { sid } => {
[840](https://docs.rs#840)                let mut drain_sub = |sid: u64| {
[841](https://docs.rs#841)                    self.drain_pings.push_back(sid);
[842](https://docs.rs#842)                    self.connection
[843](https://docs.rs#843)                        .enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Unsubscribe { sid, max: None });
[844](https://docs.rs#844)                };
[845](https://docs.rs#845)
[846](https://docs.rs#846)                if let Some(sid) = sid {
[847](https://docs.rs#847)                    if self.subscriptions.get_mut(&sid).is_some() {
[848](https://docs.rs#848)                        drain_sub(sid);
[849](https://docs.rs#849)                    }
[850](https://docs.rs#850)                } else {
[851](https://docs.rs#851)                    // sid isn't set, so drain the whole client
[852](https://docs.rs#852)                    self.connector.events_tx.try_send(Event::Draining).ok();
[853](https://docs.rs#853)                    self.is_draining = true;
[854](https://docs.rs#854)                    for (&sid, _) in self.subscriptions.iter_mut() {
[855](https://docs.rs#855)                        drain_sub(sid);
[856](https://docs.rs#856)                    }
[857](https://docs.rs#857)                }
[858](https://docs.rs#858)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Ping);
[859](https://docs.rs#859)            }
[860](https://docs.rs#860)            Command::Subscribe {
[861](https://docs.rs#861)                sid,
[862](https://docs.rs#862)                subject,
[863](https://docs.rs#863)                queue_group,
[864](https://docs.rs#864)                sender,
[865](https://docs.rs#865)            } => {
[866](https://docs.rs#866)                let subscription = Subscription {
[867](https://docs.rs#867)                    sender,
[868](https://docs.rs#868)                    delivered: 0,
[869](https://docs.rs#869)                    max: None,
[870](https://docs.rs#870)                    subject: subject.to_owned(),
[871](https://docs.rs#871)                    queue_group: queue_group.to_owned(),
[872](https://docs.rs#872)                };
[873](https://docs.rs#873)
[874](https://docs.rs#874)                self.subscriptions.insert(sid, subscription);
[875](https://docs.rs#875)
[876](https://docs.rs#876)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Subscribe {
[877](https://docs.rs#877)                    sid,
[878](https://docs.rs#878)                    subject,
[879](https://docs.rs#879)                    queue_group,
[880](https://docs.rs#880)                });
[881](https://docs.rs#881)            }
[882](https://docs.rs#882)            Command::Request {
[883](https://docs.rs#883)                subject,
[884](https://docs.rs#884)                payload,
[885](https://docs.rs#885)                respond,
[886](https://docs.rs#886)                headers,
[887](https://docs.rs#887)                sender,
[888](https://docs.rs#888)            } => {
[889](https://docs.rs#889)                let (prefix, token) = respond.rsplit_once('.').expect("malformed request subject");
[890](https://docs.rs#890)
[891](https://docs.rs#891)                let multiplexer = if let Some(multiplexer) = self.multiplexer.as_mut() {
[892](https://docs.rs#892)                    multiplexer
[893](https://docs.rs#893)                } else {
[894](https://docs.rs#894)                    let prefix = Subject::from(format!("{}.{}.", prefix, id_generator::next()));
[895](https://docs.rs#895)                    let subject = Subject::from(format!("{prefix}*"));
[896](https://docs.rs#896)
[897](https://docs.rs#897)                    self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Subscribe {
[898](https://docs.rs#898)                        sid: MULTIPLEXER_SID,
[899](https://docs.rs#899)                        subject: subject.clone(),
[900](https://docs.rs#900)                        queue_group: None,
[901](https://docs.rs#901)                    });
[902](https://docs.rs#902)
[903](https://docs.rs#903)                    self.multiplexer.insert(Multiplexer {
[904](https://docs.rs#904)                        subject,
[905](https://docs.rs#905)                        prefix,
[906](https://docs.rs#906)                        senders: HashMap::new(),
[907](https://docs.rs#907)                    })
[908](https://docs.rs#908)                };
[909](https://docs.rs#909)                self.connector
[910](https://docs.rs#910)                    .connect_stats
[911](https://docs.rs#911)                    .out_messages
[912](https://docs.rs#912)                    .add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
[913](https://docs.rs#913)
[914](https://docs.rs#914)                multiplexer.senders.insert(token.to_owned(), sender);
[915](https://docs.rs#915)
[916](https://docs.rs#916)                let respond: Subject = format!("{}{}", multiplexer.prefix, token).into();
[917](https://docs.rs#917)
[918](https://docs.rs#918)                let pub_op = ClientOp::Publish {
[919](https://docs.rs#919)                    subject,
[920](https://docs.rs#920)                    payload,
[921](https://docs.rs#921)                    respond: Some(respond),
[922](https://docs.rs#922)                    headers,
[923](https://docs.rs#923)                };
[924](https://docs.rs#924)
[925](https://docs.rs#925)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&pub_op);
[926](https://docs.rs#926)            }
[927](https://docs.rs#927)
[928](https://docs.rs#928)            Command::Publish(OutboundMessage {
[929](https://docs.rs#929)                subject,
[930](https://docs.rs#930)                payload,
[931](https://docs.rs#931)                reply: respond,
[932](https://docs.rs#932)                headers,
[933](https://docs.rs#933)            }) => {
[934](https://docs.rs#934)                self.connector
[935](https://docs.rs#935)                    .connect_stats
[936](https://docs.rs#936)                    .out_messages
[937](https://docs.rs#937)                    .add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
[938](https://docs.rs#938)
[939](https://docs.rs#939)                let header_len = headers
[940](https://docs.rs#940)                    .as_ref()
[941](https://docs.rs#941)                    .map(|headers| headers.len())
[942](https://docs.rs#942)                    .unwrap_or_default();
[943](https://docs.rs#943)
[944](https://docs.rs#944)                self.connector.connect_stats.out_bytes.add(
[945](https://docs.rs#945)                    (payload.len()
[946](https://docs.rs#946)                        + respond.as_ref().map_or_else(|| 0, |r| r.len())
[947](https://docs.rs#947)                        + subject.len()
[948](https://docs.rs#948)                        + header_len) as u64,
[949](https://docs.rs#949)                    Ordering::Relaxed,
[950](https://docs.rs#950)                );
[951](https://docs.rs#951)
[952](https://docs.rs#952)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Publish {
[953](https://docs.rs#953)                    subject,
[954](https://docs.rs#954)                    payload,
[955](https://docs.rs#955)                    respond,
[956](https://docs.rs#956)                    headers,
[957](https://docs.rs#957)                });
[958](https://docs.rs#958)            }
[959](https://docs.rs#959)
[960](https://docs.rs#960)            Command::Reconnect => {
[961](https://docs.rs#961)                self.should_reconnect = true;
[962](https://docs.rs#962)            }
[963](https://docs.rs#963)
[964](https://docs.rs#964)            Command::SetServerPool { servers, result } => {
[965](https://docs.rs#965)                let _ = result.send(self.connector.set_server_pool(servers));
[966](https://docs.rs#966)            }
[967](https://docs.rs#967)
[968](https://docs.rs#968)            Command::ServerPool { result } => {
[969](https://docs.rs#969)                let _ = result.send(self.connector.server_pool());
[970](https://docs.rs#970)            }
[971](https://docs.rs#971)        }
[972](https://docs.rs#972)    }
[973](https://docs.rs#973)
[974](https://docs.rs#974)    async fn handle_disconnect(&mut self) -> Result<(), ConnectError> {
[975](https://docs.rs#975)        self.pending_pings = 0;
[976](https://docs.rs#976)        self.connector.events_tx.try_send(Event::Disconnected).ok();
[977](https://docs.rs#977)        self.connector.state_tx.send(State::Disconnected).ok();
[978](https://docs.rs#978)
[979](https://docs.rs#979)        self.handle_reconnect().await
[980](https://docs.rs#980)    }
[981](https://docs.rs#981)
[982](https://docs.rs#982)    async fn handle_reconnect(&mut self) -> Result<(), ConnectError> {
[983](https://docs.rs#983)        let (info, connection) = self.connector.connect().await?;
[984](https://docs.rs#984)        self.connection = connection;
[985](https://docs.rs#985)        let _ = self.info_sender.send(Some(info));
[986](https://docs.rs#986)
[987](https://docs.rs#987)        self.subscriptions
[988](https://docs.rs#988)            .retain(|_, subscription| !subscription.sender.is_closed());
[989](https://docs.rs#989)
[990](https://docs.rs#990)        for (sid, subscription) in &self.subscriptions {
[991](https://docs.rs#991)            self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Subscribe {
[992](https://docs.rs#992)                sid: *sid,
[993](https://docs.rs#993)                subject: subscription.subject.to_owned(),
[994](https://docs.rs#994)                queue_group: subscription.queue_group.to_owned(),
[995](https://docs.rs#995)            });
[996](https://docs.rs#996)
[997](https://docs.rs#997)            if let Some(max) = subscription.max {
[998](https://docs.rs#998)                self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Unsubscribe {
[999](https://docs.rs#999)                    sid: *sid,
[1000](https://docs.rs#1000)                    max: Some(max.saturating_sub(subscription.delivered)),
[1001](https://docs.rs#1001)                });
[1002](https://docs.rs#1002)            }
[1003](https://docs.rs#1003)        }
[1004](https://docs.rs#1004)
[1005](https://docs.rs#1005)        if let Some(multiplexer) = &self.multiplexer {
[1006](https://docs.rs#1006)            self.connection.enqueue_write_op(&ClientOp::Subscribe {
[1007](https://docs.rs#1007)                sid: MULTIPLEXER_SID,
[1008](https://docs.rs#1008)                subject: multiplexer.subject.to_owned(),
[1009](https://docs.rs#1009)                queue_group: None,
[1010](https://docs.rs#1010)            });
[1011](https://docs.rs#1011)        }
[1012](https://docs.rs#1012)        Ok(())
[1013](https://docs.rs#1013)    }

[1016](https://docs.rs#1016)/// Connects to NATS with specified options.
[1017](https://docs.rs#1017)///
[1018](https://docs.rs#1018)/// It is generally advised to use [ConnectOptions] instead, as it provides a builder for whole
[1019](https://docs.rs#1019)/// configuration.
[1020](https://docs.rs#1020)///
[1021](https://docs.rs#1021)/// # Examples
[1022](https://docs.rs#1022)/// ```
[1023](https://docs.rs#1023)/// # #[tokio::main]
[1024](https://docs.rs#1024)/// # async fn main() ->  Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1025](https://docs.rs#1025)/// let mut nc =
[1026](https://docs.rs#1026)///     async_nats::connect_with_options("demo.nats.io", async_nats::ConnectOptions::new()).await?;
[1027](https://docs.rs#1027)/// nc.publish("test", "data".into()).await?;
[1028](https://docs.rs#1028)/// # Ok(())
[1029](https://docs.rs#1029)/// # }
[1030](https://docs.rs#1030)/// ```
[1031](https://docs.rs#1031)pub async fn connect_with_options<A: ToServerAddrs>(
[1032](https://docs.rs#1032)    addrs: A,
[1033](https://docs.rs#1033)    options: ConnectOptions,
[1034](https://docs.rs#1034)) -> Result<Client, ConnectError> {
[1035](https://docs.rs#1035)    let ping_period = options.ping_interval;
[1036](https://docs.rs#1036)
[1037](https://docs.rs#1037)    let (events_tx, mut events_rx) = mpsc::channel(128);
[1038](https://docs.rs#1038)    let (state_tx, state_rx) = tokio::sync::watch::channel(State::Pending);
[1039](https://docs.rs#1039)    // We're setting it to the default server payload size.
[1040](https://docs.rs#1040)    let max_payload = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(DEFAULT_SERVER_MAX_PAYLOAD));
[1041](https://docs.rs#1041)    let statistics = Arc::new(Statistics::default());
[1042](https://docs.rs#1042)
[1043](https://docs.rs#1043)    let mut connector = Connector::new(
[1044](https://docs.rs#1044)        addrs,
[1045](https://docs.rs#1045)        ConnectorOptions {
[1046](https://docs.rs#1046)            tls_required: options.tls_required,
[1047](https://docs.rs#1047)            certificates: options.certificates,
[1048](https://docs.rs#1048)            client_key: options.client_key,
[1049](https://docs.rs#1049)            client_cert: options.client_cert,
[1050](https://docs.rs#1050)            tls_client_config: options.tls_client_config,
[1051](https://docs.rs#1051)            tls_first: options.tls_first,
[1052](https://docs.rs#1052)            auth: options.auth,
[1053](https://docs.rs#1053)            no_echo: options.no_echo,
[1054](https://docs.rs#1054)            connection_timeout: options.connection_timeout,
[1055](https://docs.rs#1055)            name: options.name,
[1056](https://docs.rs#1056)            ignore_discovered_servers: options.ignore_discovered_servers,
[1057](https://docs.rs#1057)            retain_servers_order: options.retain_servers_order,
[1058](https://docs.rs#1058)            read_buffer_capacity: options.read_buffer_capacity,
[1059](https://docs.rs#1059)            reconnect_delay_callback: options.reconnect_delay_callback,
[1060](https://docs.rs#1060)            auth_callback: options.auth_callback,
[1061](https://docs.rs#1061)            max_reconnects: options.max_reconnects,
[1062](https://docs.rs#1062)            local_address: options.local_address,
[1063](https://docs.rs#1063)            reconnect_to_server_callback: options.reconnect_to_server_callback,
[1064](https://docs.rs#1064)        },
[1065](https://docs.rs#1065)        events_tx,
[1066](https://docs.rs#1066)        state_tx,
[1067](https://docs.rs#1067)        max_payload.clone(),
[1068](https://docs.rs#1068)        statistics.clone(),
[1069](https://docs.rs#1069)    )
[1070](https://docs.rs#1070)    .map_err(|err| ConnectError::with_source(ConnectErrorKind::ServerParse, err))?;
[1071](https://docs.rs#1071)
[1072](https://docs.rs#1072)    let mut info = None;
[1073](https://docs.rs#1073)    let mut connection = None;
[1074](https://docs.rs#1074)    if !options.retry_on_initial_connect {
[1075](https://docs.rs#1075)        debug!("retry on initial connect failure is disabled");
[1076](https://docs.rs#1076)        let (info_ok, connection_ok) = connector.try_connect().await?;
[1077](https://docs.rs#1077)        connection = Some(connection_ok);
[1078](https://docs.rs#1078)        info = Some(info_ok);
[1079](https://docs.rs#1079)    }
[1080](https://docs.rs#1080)
[1081](https://docs.rs#1081)    let (info_sender, info_watcher) = tokio::sync::watch::channel(info.clone());
[1082](https://docs.rs#1082)    let (sender, mut receiver) = mpsc::channel(options.sender_capacity);
[1083](https://docs.rs#1083)
[1084](https://docs.rs#1084)    let client = Client::new(
[1085](https://docs.rs#1085)        info_watcher,
[1086](https://docs.rs#1086)        state_rx,
[1087](https://docs.rs#1087)        sender,
[1088](https://docs.rs#1088)        options.subscription_capacity,
[1089](https://docs.rs#1089)        options.inbox_prefix,
[1090](https://docs.rs#1090)        options.request_timeout,
[1091](https://docs.rs#1091)        max_payload,
[1092](https://docs.rs#1092)        statistics,
[1093](https://docs.rs#1093)        options.skip_subject_validation,
[1094](https://docs.rs#1094)    );
[1095](https://docs.rs#1095)
[1096](https://docs.rs#1096)    task::spawn(async move {
[1097](https://docs.rs#1097)        while let Some(event) = events_rx.recv().await {
[1098](https://docs.rs#1098)            tracing::info!("event: {}", event);
[1099](https://docs.rs#1099)            if let Some(event_callback) = &options.event_callback {
[1100](https://docs.rs#1100)                event_callback.call(event).await;
[1101](https://docs.rs#1101)            }
[1102](https://docs.rs#1102)        }
[1103](https://docs.rs#1103)    });
[1104](https://docs.rs#1104)
[1105](https://docs.rs#1105)    task::spawn(async move {
[1106](https://docs.rs#1106)        if connection.is_none() && options.retry_on_initial_connect {
[1107](https://docs.rs#1107)            let (info, connection_ok) = match connector.connect().await {
[1108](https://docs.rs#1108)                Ok((info, connection)) => (info, connection),
[1109](https://docs.rs#1109)                Err(err) => {
[1110](https://docs.rs#1110)                    error!("connection closed: {}", err);
[1111](https://docs.rs#1111)                    return;
[1112](https://docs.rs#1112)                }
[1113](https://docs.rs#1113)            };
[1114](https://docs.rs#1114)            info_sender.send(Some(info)).ok();
[1115](https://docs.rs#1115)            connection = Some(connection_ok);
[1116](https://docs.rs#1116)        }
[1117](https://docs.rs#1117)        let connection = connection.unwrap();
[1118](https://docs.rs#1118)        let mut connection_handler =
[1119](https://docs.rs#1119)            ConnectionHandler::new(connection, connector, info_sender, ping_period);
[1120](https://docs.rs#1120)        connection_handler.process(&mut receiver).await

[1122](https://docs.rs#1122)
[1123](https://docs.rs#1123)    Ok(client)

[1159](https://docs.rs#1159)/// # Examples

[1161](https://docs.rs#1161)/// ## Single URL

[1166](https://docs.rs#1166)/// nc.publish("test", "data".into()).await?;
[1167](https://docs.rs#1167)/// # Ok(())
[1168](https://docs.rs#1168)/// # }
[1169](https://docs.rs#1169)/// ```
[1170](https://docs.rs#1170)///
[1171](https://docs.rs#1171)/// ## Connect with [Vec] of [ServerAddr].
[1172](https://docs.rs#1172)/// ```no_run
[1173](https://docs.rs#1173)/// #[tokio::main]
[1174](https://docs.rs#1174)/// # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1175](https://docs.rs#1175)/// use async_nats::ServerAddr;
[1176](https://docs.rs#1176)/// let client = async_nats::connect(vec![
[1177](https://docs.rs#1177)///     "demo.nats.io".parse::<ServerAddr>()?,
[1178](https://docs.rs#1178)///     "other.nats.io".parse::<ServerAddr>()?,
[1179](https://docs.rs#1179)/// ])
[1180](https://docs.rs#1180)/// .await
[1181](https://docs.rs#1181)/// .unwrap();
[1182](https://docs.rs#1182)/// # Ok(())
[1183](https://docs.rs#1183)/// # }
[1184](https://docs.rs#1184)/// ```
[1185](https://docs.rs#1185)///
[1186](https://docs.rs#1186)/// ## with [Vec], but parse URLs inside [crate::connect()]
[1187](https://docs.rs#1187)/// ```no_run
[1188](https://docs.rs#1188)/// #[tokio::main]
[1189](https://docs.rs#1189)/// # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1190](https://docs.rs#1190)/// use async_nats::ServerAddr;
[1191](https://docs.rs#1191)/// let servers = vec!["demo.nats.io", "other.nats.io"];
[1192](https://docs.rs#1192)/// let client = async_nats::connect(

[1301](https://docs.rs#1301)    /// Unsubscribes from subscription, draining all remaining messages.
[1302](https://docs.rs#1302)    ///
[1303](https://docs.rs#1303)    /// # Examples
[1304](https://docs.rs#1304)    /// ```
[1305](https://docs.rs#1305)    /// # #[tokio::main]
[1306](https://docs.rs#1306)    /// # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1307](https://docs.rs#1307)    /// let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[1308](https://docs.rs#1308)    ///

[1310](https://docs.rs#1310)    ///

[1313](https://docs.rs#1313)    /// # }
[1314](https://docs.rs#1314)    /// ```
[1315](https://docs.rs#1315)    pub async fn unsubscribe(&mut self) -> Result<(), UnsubscribeError> {
[1316](https://docs.rs#1316)        self.sender
[1317](https://docs.rs#1317)            .send(Command::Unsubscribe {
[1318](https://docs.rs#1318)                sid: self.sid,
[1319](https://docs.rs#1319)                max: None,
[1320](https://docs.rs#1320)            })
[1321](https://docs.rs#1321)            .await?;
[1322](https://docs.rs#1322)        self.receiver.close();
[1323](https://docs.rs#1323)        Ok(())
[1324](https://docs.rs#1324)    }
[1325](https://docs.rs#1325)
[1326](https://docs.rs#1326)    /// Unsubscribes from subscription after reaching given number of messages.
[1327](https://docs.rs#1327)    /// This is the total number of messages received by this subscription in it's whole
[1328](https://docs.rs#1328)    /// lifespan. If it already reached or surpassed the passed value, it will immediately stop.
[1329](https://docs.rs#1329)    ///
[1330](https://docs.rs#1330)    /// # Examples
[1331](https://docs.rs#1331)    /// ```
[1332](https://docs.rs#1332)    /// # use futures_util::StreamExt;
[1333](https://docs.rs#1333)    /// # #[tokio::main]
[1334](https://docs.rs#1334)    /// # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1335](https://docs.rs#1335)    /// let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[1336](https://docs.rs#1336)    ///
[1337](https://docs.rs#1337)    /// let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("test").await?;
[1338](https://docs.rs#1338)    /// subscriber.unsubscribe_after(3).await?;
[1339](https://docs.rs#1339)    ///
[1340](https://docs.rs#1340)    /// for _ in 0..3 {
[1341](https://docs.rs#1341)    ///     client.publish("test", "data".into()).await?;
[1342](https://docs.rs#1342)    /// }
[1343](https://docs.rs#1343)    ///
[1344](https://docs.rs#1344)    /// while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
[1345](https://docs.rs#1345)    ///     println!("message received: {:?}", message);
[1346](https://docs.rs#1346)    /// }
[1347](https://docs.rs#1347)    /// println!("no more messages, unsubscribed");
[1348](https://docs.rs#1348)    /// # Ok(())
[1349](https://docs.rs#1349)    /// # }
[1350](https://docs.rs#1350)    /// ```
[1351](https://docs.rs#1351)    pub async fn unsubscribe_after(&mut self, unsub_after: u64) -> Result<(), UnsubscribeError> {
[1352](https://docs.rs#1352)        self.sender
[1353](https://docs.rs#1353)            .send(Command::Unsubscribe {
[1354](https://docs.rs#1354)                sid: self.sid,
[1355](https://docs.rs#1355)                max: Some(unsub_after),
[1356](https://docs.rs#1356)            })
[1357](https://docs.rs#1357)            .await?;
[1358](https://docs.rs#1358)        Ok(())
[1359](https://docs.rs#1359)    }
[1360](https://docs.rs#1360)
[1361](https://docs.rs#1361)    /// Unsubscribes immediately but leaves the subscription open to allow any in-flight messages
[1362](https://docs.rs#1362)    /// on the subscription to be delivered. The stream will be closed after any remaining messages
[1363](https://docs.rs#1363)    /// are delivered
[1364](https://docs.rs#1364)    ///
[1365](https://docs.rs#1365)    /// # Examples
[1366](https://docs.rs#1366)    /// ```no_run
[1367](https://docs.rs#1367)    /// # use futures_util::StreamExt;
[1368](https://docs.rs#1368)    /// # #[tokio::main]
[1369](https://docs.rs#1369)    /// # async fn main() -> Result<(), async_nats::Error> {
[1370](https://docs.rs#1370)    /// let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
[1371](https://docs.rs#1371)    ///
[1372](https://docs.rs#1372)    /// let mut subscriber = client.subscribe("test").await?;
[1373](https://docs.rs#1373)    ///
[1374](https://docs.rs#1374)    /// tokio::spawn({
[1375](https://docs.rs#1375)    ///     let task_client = client.clone();
[1376](https://docs.rs#1376)    ///     async move {
[1377](https://docs.rs#1377)    ///         loop {
[1378](https://docs.rs#1378)    ///             _ = task_client.publish("test", "data".into()).await;
[1379](https://docs.rs#1379)    ///         }
[1380](https://docs.rs#1380)    ///     }
[1381](https://docs.rs#1381)    /// });
[1382](https://docs.rs#1382)    ///
[1383](https://docs.rs#1383)    /// client.flush().await?;
[1384](https://docs.rs#1384)    /// subscriber.drain().await?;
[1385](https://docs.rs#1385)    ///
[1386](https://docs.rs#1386)    /// while let Some(message) = subscriber.next().await {
[1387](https://docs.rs#1387)    ///     println!("message received: {:?}", message);
[1388](https://docs.rs#1388)    /// }
[1389](https://docs.rs#1389)    /// println!("no more messages, unsubscribed");
[1390](https://docs.rs#1390)    /// # Ok(())
[1391](https://docs.rs#1391)    /// # }
[1392](https://docs.rs#1392)    /// ```
[1393](https://docs.rs#1393)    pub async fn drain(&mut self) -> Result<(), UnsubscribeError> {
[1394](https://docs.rs#1394)        self.sender
[1395](https://docs.rs#1395)            .send(Command::Drain {

[1397](https://docs.rs#1397)            })
[1398](https://docs.rs#1398)            .await?;
[1399](https://docs.rs#1399)
[1400](https://docs.rs#1400)        Ok(())
[1401](https://docs.rs#1401)    }

[1513](https://docs.rs#1513)pub struct ConnectInfo {

[1520](https://docs.rs#1520)

[1531](https://docs.rs#1531)
[1532](https://docs.rs#1532)    /// Optional client name.

[1534](https://docs.rs#1534)
[1535](https://docs.rs#1535)    /// If set to `true`, the server (version 1.2.0+) will not send originating

[1537](https://docs.rs#1537)    /// set this to `true` only for server supporting this feature, which is

[1543](https://docs.rs#1543)
[1544](https://docs.rs#1544)    /// The version of the client.
[1545](https://docs.rs#1545)    pub version: String,
[1546](https://docs.rs#1546)
[1547](https://docs.rs#1547)    /// Sending 0 (or absent) indicates client supports original protocol.
[1548](https://docs.rs#1548)    /// Sending 1 indicates that the client supports dynamic reconfiguration

[1600](https://docs.rs#1600)                ErrorKind::InvalidInput,

[1602](https://docs.rs#1602)            )
[1603](https://docs.rs#1603)        })?;
[1604](https://docs.rs#1604)
[1605](https://docs.rs#1605)        Self::from_url(url)

[1777](https://docs.rs#1777)        return false;

[1779](https://docs.rs#1779)
[1780](https://docs.rs#1780)    memchr::memchr3(b' ', b'\r', b'\n', bytes).is_none() && memchr::memchr(b'\t', bytes).is_none()
[1781](https://docs.rs#1781)}

[1794](https://docs.rs#1794)        && bytes[bytes.len() - 1] != b'.'
[1795](https://docs.rs#1795)        && memchr::memmem::find(bytes, b"..").is_none()

[1815](https://docs.rs#1815)    ($t:ty, $k:ty, $origin: ty, $origin_kind: ty) => {
[1816](https://docs.rs#1816)        impl From<$origin> for $t {
[1817](https://docs.rs#1817)            fn from(err: $origin) -> Self {
[1818](https://docs.rs#1818)                match err.kind() {
[1819](https://docs.rs#1819)                    <$origin_kind>::TimedOut => Self::new(<$k>::TimedOut),
[1820](https://docs.rs#1820)                    _ => Self::with_source(<$k>::Other, err),
[1821](https://docs.rs#1821)                }
[1822](https://docs.rs#1822)            }
[1823](https://docs.rs#1823)        }
[1824](https://docs.rs#1824)    };

Create will add the key/value pair if it does not exist. If it does exist, it will return an error. It will set a TTL specific for that key.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-2)Examples

```
use std::time::Duration;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io:4222").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);

    .create_key_value(async_nats::jetstream::kv::Config {
        bucket: "kv".to_string(),
        history: 10,
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .await?;
let status = kv
    .create_with_ttl("key", "value".into(), Duration::from_secs(10))
    .await;
assert!(status.is_ok());
```

#### pub async fn [watch_all_from_revision](https://docs.rs#method.watch_all_from_revision)(
    &self,
    revision: [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html),
) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[Watch](https://docs.rs/struct.Watch.html), [WatchError](https://docs.rs/type.WatchError.html)>

Creates a [futures_util::Stream](https://docs.rs/futures-core/0.3.32/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/futures_core/stream/trait.Stream.html) over [Entries](https://docs.rs/struct.Entry.html) for all keys starting
from a provider revision. This can be useful when resuming watching over a big bucket
without the need to replay all the history.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-12)Examples

```
use futures_util::StreamExt;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io:4222").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
let kv = jetstream
    .create_key_value(async_nats::jetstream::kv::Config {
        bucket: "kv".to_string(),
        history: 10,
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .await?;
let mut entries = kv.watch_all_from_revision(40).await?;
while let Some(entry) = entries.next().await {
    println!("entry: {:?}", entry);
}
```
Retrieves the [Entry](https://docs.rs/struct.Entry.html) for a given key from a bucket.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-13)Examples

A blob store capable of storing large objects efficiently in streams.

### impl [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html)

Gets an [Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html) from the [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html).

[Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html) implements [tokio::io::AsyncRead](https://docs.rs/tokio/1.52.3/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/tokio/io/async_read/trait.AsyncRead.html) that allows
to read the data from Object Store.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples)Examples

```
use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
let bucket = jetstream.get_object_store("store").await?;
let mut object = bucket.get("FOO").await?;
// Object implements `tokio::io::AsyncRead`.
let mut bytes = vec![];
object.read_to_end(&mut bytes).await?;
```

let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
let mut bucket = jetstream.get_object_store("store").await?;
bucket
    .update_metadata(
        "object",
        object_store::UpdateMetadata {
            name: "new_name".to_string(),
            description: Some("a new description".to_string()),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await?;
```
Adds a link to an [Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html).
It creates a new [Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html) in the [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html) that points to another [Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html)
and does not have any contents on it’s own.
Links are automatically followed (one level deep) when calling [ObjectStore::get](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html#method.get).

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-8)Examples

```
use async_nats::jetstream::object_store;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
let bucket = jetstream.get_object_store("bucket").await?;
let object = bucket.get("object").await?;
bucket.add_link("link_to_object", &object).await?;
```
Adds a link to another [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html) bucket by creating a new [Object](https://docs.rs/struct.Object.html)
in the current [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html) that points to another [ObjectStore](https://docs.rs/struct.ObjectStore.html) and
does not contain any data.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-9)Examples

```
use async_nats::jetstream::object_store;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let jetstream = async_nats::jetstream::new(client);
let bucket = jetstream.get_object_store("bucket").await?;
bucket
    .add_bucket_link("link_to_object", "another_bucket")
    .await?;
```

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#918-924)#### pub async fn [drain](https://docs.rs#method.drain)(&self) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[()](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.unit.html), [DrainError](https://docs.rs/struct.DrainError.html)>

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#918-924)

#### pub async fn [drain](https://docs.rs#method.drain)(&self) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[()](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.unit.html), [DrainError](https://docs.rs/struct.DrainError.html)>

Drains all subscriptions, stops any new messages from being published, and flushes any remaining
messages, then closes the connection. Once completed, any streams associated with the
connection and its [Clients](https://docs.rs/struct.Client.html) will be closed, and further [crate::Client](https://docs.rs/struct.Client.html) commands will fail.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-16)Examples

```
use futures_util::StreamExt;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let mut subscription = client.subscribe("events.>").await?;
client.drain().await?;
assert!(subscription.next().await.is_none());
client
    .subscribe("events.>")
    .await
    .expect_err("Expected further commands to fail");
```

#### pub async fn [force_reconnect](https://docs.rs#method.force_reconnect)(&self) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[()](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.unit.html), [ReconnectError](https://docs.rs/struct.ReconnectError.html)>

Forces the client to reconnect.
Keep in mind that client will reconnect automatically if the connection is lost and this
method does not have to be used in normal circumstances.
However, if you want to force the client to reconnect, for example to re-trigger
the `auth-callback`, or manually rebalance connections, this method can be useful.
This method does not wait for connection to be re-established.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-18)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
client.force_reconnect().await?;
```
[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#990-1019)#### pub async fn [set_server_pool](https://docs.rs#method.set_server_pool)<A: [ToServerAddrs](https://docs.rs/trait.ToServerAddrs.html)>(
    &self,
    addrs: A,
) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[()](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.unit.html), [SetServerPoolError](https://docs.rs/type.SetServerPoolError.html)>

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#990-1019)

#### pub async fn [set_server_pool](https://docs.rs#method.set_server_pool)<A: [ToServerAddrs](https://docs.rs/trait.ToServerAddrs.html)>(
    &self,
    addrs: A,
) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[()](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.unit.html), [SetServerPoolError](https://docs.rs/type.SetServerPoolError.html)>

Replaces the server pool used for reconnection attempts.

The new pool takes effect on the next reconnect attempt; it does not
trigger an immediate reconnect. To force an immediate reconnect with
the new pool, call [ Client::force_reconnect](https://docs.rs/struct.Client.html#method.force_reconnect) after this method.

Per-server state (failed attempt count, connection history) is preserved for servers that appear in both the old and new pools.

This also resets the global reconnection attempt counter, so any
progress toward [ ConnectOptions::max_reconnects](https://docs.rs/struct.ConnectOptions.html#method.max_reconnects)
is cleared.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-19)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
client
    .set_server_pool(["nats://server1:4222", "nats://server2:4222"].as_slice())
    .await?;
// Optionally force reconnect to apply immediately:
client.force_reconnect().await?;
```
[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#1042-1051)#### pub async fn [server_pool](https://docs.rs#method.server_pool)(&self) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[Server](https://docs.rs/struct.Server.html)>, [ServerPoolError](https://docs.rs/type.ServerPoolError.html)>

#### pub async fn [server_pool](https://docs.rs#method.server_pool)(&self) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[Server](https://docs.rs/struct.Server.html)>, [ServerPoolError](https://docs.rs/type.ServerPoolError.html)>

Returns a snapshot of the current server pool.

The returned list includes both explicitly configured and discovered servers, along with per-server metadata such as reconnect count and connection history.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-20)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let pool = client.server_pool().await?;
for server in &pool {
    println!(
        "{:?}: {} failed attempts",
        server.addr, server.failed_attempts
    );
}
```

#### pub fn [statistics](https://docs.rs#method.statistics)(&self) -> [Arc](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/sync/struct.Arc.html)<[Statistics](https://docs.rs/struct.Statistics.html)> [ⓘ](https://docs.rs)

Returns struct representing statistics of the whole lifecycle of the client.
This includes number of bytes sent/received, number of messages sent/received,
and number of times the connection was established.
As this returns [Arc](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/sync/struct.Arc.html) with [AtomicU64](https://docs.rs/portable-atomic/1.13.1/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/portable_atomic/struct.AtomicU64.html) fields, it can be safely reused and shared
across threads.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-21)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let statistics = client.statistics();
println!("client statistics: {:#?}", statistics);
```

`pub struct HeaderName { /* private fields */ }`## Expand description

Defines a NATS header field name

Header field names identify the header. Header sets may include multiple headers with the same name.

[§](https://docs.rs#representation)Representation

`HeaderName` represents standard header names using an `enum`, as such they
will not require an allocation for storage.

`inbox: `[Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<[String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html)>## Implementations[§](https://docs.rs#implementations)

[Source](https://docs.rs/src/async_nats/client.rs.html#1084-1086)

Sets the payload of the request. If not used, empty payload will be sent.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let request = async_nats::Request::new().payload("data".into());
client.send_request("service", request).await?;
```
Sets the headers of the requests.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-1)Examples

```
use std::str::FromStr;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let mut headers = async_nats::HeaderMap::new();
headers.insert(
    "X-Example",
    async_nats::HeaderValue::from_str("Value").unwrap(),
);
let request = async_nats::Request::new()
    .headers(headers)
    .payload("data".into());
client.send_request("service", request).await?;
```
Sets the custom timeout of the request. Overrides default [Client](https://docs.rs/struct.Client.html) timeout.
Setting it to [Option::None](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.None) disables the timeout entirely which might result in deadlock.
To use default timeout, simply do not call this function.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-2)Examples

```
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let request = async_nats::Request::new()
    .timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(15)))
    .payload("data".into());
client.send_request("service", request).await?;
```
Sets custom inbox for this request. Overrides both customized and default [Client](https://docs.rs/struct.Client.html) Inbox.

[§](https://docs.rs#examples-3)Examples

```
use std::str::FromStr;
let client = async_nats::connect("demo.nats.io").await?;
let request = async_nats::Request::new()
    .inbox("custom_inbox".into())
    .payload("data".into());
client.send_request("service", request).await?;
```

# RequestErrorKind in async_nats::client - Rust
